Game Overview

In The End of the Tunnel, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of The End of the Tunnel follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is The End of the Tunnel?

The End of the Tunnel is a free board game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is The End of the Tunnel free to play?

Yes, The End of the Tunnel is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
